implication_for_port: The serialized scene begins with the Night global Volume, whose Tonemapping is active and set to Neutral. The day/night controller can switch that Volume to the Day profile; in that profile Tonemapping and ColorAdjustments components are both inactive, even though the disabled ColorAdjustments payload stores +3.48 EV. Neither effective profile indicates an applied positive exposure lift. The bright ceiling still warrants checking intermediate LDR clipping, point-light range/attenuation, and active scene ColorCurves/ChannelMixer data before adding output transforms.
